chat.body: Why does usePokemon read the store itself instead of taking the trainer as an argument?

`usePokemon()` calls `usePokemonFilters()` with a selector for `trainerId`, so `<PokemonPage />` passes it nothing and the hook renders again only when the trainer changes. `<PokemonFilters />` writes the same store, so the list follows the select with no props between the two components.
